workItems.rationale: Extends record persistence and CAS semantics across authoritative records and rebuildable projections; includes store/reindex tests.

workItems.title: Derive enforced routes and normalize `ready_with_corrections`
workItems.rationale: Central policy matrix combines budget, architecture, semantic action, closure evidence, and compatibility mode; includes exhaustive matrix tests.

workItems.title: Implement typed human-gate prompt flow and idempotent decision actions
workItems.rationale: Adds a concurrency-sensitive prompt/decision boundary and explicit tradeoff payloads; includes CAS, stale-gate, and repeated-decision tests.

workItems.title: Integrate governance with reviewer recording and later prompt context
workItems.rationale: Coordinates protocol/invoke writers, atomic records, decision folding, and prompt rendering without duplicating plan-208 seams; includes writer parity tests.

workItems.title: Rewrite reviewer templates and plan-review skills for closure routing
workItems.rationale: Updates bundled workflow contracts and route handling across native/invoke modes; includes rendered-asset tests.

workItems.title: Add authenticated dashboard forecast, debt, gate, and decision surfaces
workItems.rationale: Extends the prerequisite server, versioned API/WS messages, and browser components/actions; includes auth and browser smoke tests.

workItems.title: Complete end-to-end compatibility, race, audit, and documentation coverage
workItems.rationale: Validates multi-round behavior and advisory/off compatibility across CLI and dashboard; includes integration fixtures and docs.
